newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia's Jan import prices rise 0.7 pct.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia's Jan import prices rise 0.7 pct.

text.p: Australia's import prices rose 0.7 percent in January from the previous month, and were 6.3 percent lower than a year before, the Australian Bureau of Statistics said on Tuesday.
"Prices for petroleum and related products rose by 4.9 percent due to world oil price increases," the bureau said.
"Machinery and transport equipment prices rose slightly."
It was the first rise in the index since a 0.5 percent increase in August last year.
The annual rate of import price inflation has remained between minus 6.1 percent and minus 9.7 percent since May last year.
